title: NL coast: easy 50 flat, cadence session
terrain: firm wet sand at the waterline, flat, no dunes today
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: easy 50 flat on firm sand or road, no dunes today. The job is cadence, not fitness: 165-170 spm on flat and shallow downhill, metronome or a 165 bpm playlist, shorter steps at the same effort. Step width slightly wider than natural. Turn around every 10-15min for the camber.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 Enervit Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro for the hour, 150-250ml water each. Every run over an hour between now and 5 Sep is gut training.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day.
WHY IT MATTERS: no second sand-climbing day 48h apart, that is how a new surface becomes an Achilles problem. At 96h post-shockwave the analgesic window is thinning, so what the knee reports today and tomorrow morning is the most informative reading of the week. It decides how much of the 5 Sep rehearsal gets restored.
